note: REAL SADKO campaign artwork, downloaded from the company's own live homepage (https://sadko-group.com/) on 2026-09-05 and stored under assets/img/promos/. The banner text is baked into the images in Arabic; `title`/`sub` transcribe what each image says so screen readers and the English side have an equivalent. Do not add a 'was' price, discount %, rating or stock claim here — the catalogue carries no discount data, and these banners make none.
placement: hero = the rotating banner at the top of shop.html; slot = the ad blocks interleaved between the shop's sections. Slots are dealt out in the order below: the first goes in the wide single-banner block, the rest fill the square ad row, so a wide banner should come first.
notIncluded: assets/img/promos/tile-hotline.jpg (the 19140 strip) was downloaded but is not listed: it is 285x155, so the square ad tile cropped the number to '9140'. The hotline already appears in the header and the footer. Kept in the folder in case a square version is produced.
